name: cavemio-expanding-button-group
title: Expanding button group
description: Icon toolbar where the action you point at, tab to or tap opens its label while neighbours slide aside, with ask-first and done states in place.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="toolbar" with one tab stop: arrows, Home and End move between actions; keyboard focus opens the label.
- Hover is read from pointer movement, so a label opening under a still cursor never hands the hover to its neighbour.
- Ask and done labels are announced through a status region outside the toolbar.
- Reduced motion: labels open and close in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · Actions: id, label, icon, tone (default | primary | danger), confirm, confirmLabel, onClick, disabled.

props.name: expandedId
props.description: – · Controlled item that stays open while nothing is pointed at.

props.name: defaultExpandedId
props.description: null · Item that stays open while nothing is pointed at.

props.name: size
props.description: "md" · 24px buttons in a 32px bar, or 28px in 36px.

features.title: Interruptible expansion
features.description: The label column eases 0fr → 1fr in 400ms; pointing at another icon mid-way retargets from where it is.

features.title: Sliding neighbours
features.description: Neighbouring buttons slide aside with rational easing curves as the active item grows.

features.title: Ask, then act
features.description: Items with confirm morph their label to "Delete?" and act on the next press; items with confirmLabel answer with a drawn check.

features.title: Touch that works
features.description: Hover follows real mouse movement only; on touch a tap acts and opens the label for a moment so you see what you pressed.

features.title: Semantic tones
features.description: Supports default neutral, primary, and danger tone pills for critical actions like Delete.

states.title: resting
states.description: A row of 28px icon buttons in a 36px thin line capsule; defaultExpandedId stays open while nothing is pointed at.

states.title: open
states.description: The pointed-at, focused or tapped item fills and its label rises out of a 4px blur while its column eases open (400ms); the previous one folds at the same time.

states.title: ask
states.description: An item with confirm morphs its label ("Delete" → "Delete?"); the next press acts. 3s, Escape or pointing elsewhere cancels.

states.title: done
states.description: An item with confirmLabel swaps its icon for a drawn emerald check and morphs its label for 1.6s.
